'''The Admiral Wow a good deck...''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[The Admiral]]
* '''Published:''' 8 December 2001 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Theed Palace]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can|SE-L-mindwhatyouhavelearned.gif|label=Mind What You Have Learned}}
* '''Strategy:''' Mind What You Have Learned
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PTheed MWYHL Admiral LS 2001 GPN.txt |Download]]

This is what is commonly called a good deck, even if it looks like a pile.

== Strategy ==

Well the idea is to draw out their shields, while doing all the other stuff that Dagocheese decks do. Start the Podrace Prep w/ Seeking An Audience as the effect. This deck is very unusual and I don't really feel like explaining my reasoning for every card except the objective so if you have any questions or whatever AIM me at admiralthrawnMT. Thanks!
